PA policy coding rules from purchased examples:
- Code the main substantive policy described by a bill, not incidental wording or the statute title alone.
- Amendments to child protective services, child abuse definitions or exclusions, founded/indicated reports, expungement, investigations, and court evidence belong to child abuse/protection under code 1207. Studies of child abuse services and immunity for persons representing minors also map to 1207.
- Volunteer week designations and volunteer service/nonprofit social-service organizations are code 1305 (Social Services and Volunteer Associations), even when the bill is only a commemorative resolution. This code also includes sales-tax exemptions for charitable, volunteer, and religious organizations.
- Requirements for state agencies to lease or purchase Pennsylvania motor vehicles/products are state procurement/preference rules, code 2007 (government and government contractor purchasing requirements for PA/US-produced products), rather than transportation merely because vehicles are mentioned.
- Senior-citizen property-tax/rent rebates and inflation dividend eligibility or schedules are code 1303 (property tax relief / assistance for elderly and disabled), not general taxation code 107.
- Realty transfer tax changes or exclusions for property transfers are code 1213, not general state taxation.
- Probation violation sanctions are sentencing/criminal law under code 1210.
- Tartan Day and comparable cultural/ethnic commemorative designations map to code 201 (cultural activities and historical commemorations).
- Teacher loan forgiveness provisions belong to higher education/student financial aid, code 601.
- Health insurer requirements to offer second medical opinions before surgery are code 302 (health insurance and medical care access).
- Studies about eliminating or reducing local school property taxes as a funding source map to code 2404 (local taxation and property tax relief), not state tax policy or education.
- Civil service restrictions on political activity and public employee financial-interest disclosure/ethics requirements map to code 2012 (state government personnel/ethics).
- Early retirement eligibility provisions changing public school/state employee pension benefits map to code 2004 (state government retirement benefits).
- County controller accounts and annual budget under a county code are local government operations, code 2401, not the state operating budget code 105.
